action: Enroll in NEMT (Non-Emergency Medical Transport) driver certification course at Millfield Community College. Pay the $320 course registration fee this week. The course is 6 weeks, evenings only. I can keep driving daytime shifts while completing it. NEMT drivers are not being replaced by RoboRide — the liability exposure and regulatory complexity of transporting medical patients makes autonomous vehicles nonviable in that segment for the foreseeable future. This is the retrain move I identified last tick. I am done researching it. I am registering.
